His INR is above its stated goal, and he has bruising, gum bleeding, and a lower hemoglobin while warfarin, aspirin, and naproxen are listed; please contact his anticoagulation clinic or doctor today. His kidney function has also worsened from the prior result, and potassium is above the report range, so those results need timely follow-up. Standing dizziness and a nighttime fall occurred while several medicines that can affect blood pressure are listed, though no blood-pressure drop on standing was recorded. Two statins are listed alongside thigh aches and a mildly high CK. These are patterns to discuss with his doctors, not conclusions about what is causing the symptoms.
